reviews.t: Love my new maxi mist!
reviews.x: I recently ordered the maxi mist lite plus. I have been wanting a tanning machine for quite some time, and was tired if the inconvenience of going to a salon. I am very glad that I decided to go with the maxi mist! It is very easy to put together, and very easy to use as well. The spray comes out in a fine mist so there is no streaking,  and the color very even. I also liked the tanning solution that was included in the kit, I'm still tan, and I used the machine 6 days ago.

reviews.t: It took a couple tries to get the spray nozzle ...
reviews.x: It took a couple tries to get the spray nozzle right.  It is loud, more so than I expected (louder than my hair drier).  It gets the job done and gives an even tan (once the sprayer situation was resolved.)  I still can't for the life of me figure out how to fold the tent back up though, but thats ok!  The solution that comes with are decent, and they have different levels of DHA  so you can try a lighter tan to darker.  I mixed a couple just to experiment.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the machine's performance, saying it sprays evenly and works great or better than expected.
Many reviewers find the tent easy to set up and take down, though a few complain it is difficult to put away and stains easily if not cleaned immediately.
Several reviewers did not like the included tanning solution and instead bought Norvell solution separately.
Reviewers frequently describe the kit as great value and cost-effective compared to salon tans.
Multiple reviewers note it works well for home use with a partner spraying them, and is suitable for beginners or even professional use.
